scope: Final independent read-only483 production review against HEAD after root moved the single whole-working-context guard into SubmissionBatch::submit before application lookup/drain. No production/test edits or Rust checks by reviewer. Earlier intermediate source review retained.

findings.issue: A prepared host callback could reserve then panic; catching it inside the outer ingress scope left rejected reservations live.
findings.resolution: SubmissionBatch::submit mem::take leaves self.validation default before drain/application lookup; local validation passes into submit_validated and restores only onOk. Any failed result or provider/lookup unwind drops local state; inner protected-control success restores the already-reset default. Earlier admitted originals remain owned. Ninth public regression is source-linked; actual execution receipt belongs to router-test owner.

review_result: No remaining production blocker found in observed source after focused panic fix.

checked_invariants.guard_order: closed, binding, failed owner, group/leader, command shape/control, request count preflight, applied boundary, Core-context, exact validation, receipt bound, charged bytes, final capacity/sequence, tracked admission, original router indexes/credits. Legacy submit passes None to the same path. Node preserves draining before application lookup.
checked_invariants.cache_lifetime: One contiguous group/application/applied-index run. First accepted original full validator, second may prepare once; None retained only for run. Error/control/group/app/applied changes reset. Entire local context moves out before application lookup and restores only on successful admission; result errors or any caught lookup/provider unwind leave member default. No worker/Core/application transitions through capability; callback completion drops state, accepted originals remain owned.
checked_invariants.pending_and_fallback: Factory sees the unchanged ordered unapplied durable commands followed by all retained same-group client commands. Prepared capability cannot retain temporary pending-item references through independent iterator/application lifetimes. Ready-only providers do not opt into ingress; general opt-in does not grant supports_ready_batch.
checked_invariants.counter: Exact480 helper and legacy full Counter validator semantics retained. Owned operation-ID reservations, immutable dedup/applied state, syntax-before-deferred pending capacity, full receipt bound and plain wrapper enlargement unchanged; Maintenance None fallback.
checked_invariants.routing_and_timer: Offered loop still decides at most64 originals, reads now per original before due/begin/window check, tests replica readiness in original index order with exact Leader+current-term-commit predicate, submits/records one result immediately and drops all scopes before maintenance/next poll. Existing maintenance/output/start/drain/latency boundaries unchanged; no request precollection or gathering delay.
checked_invariants.authority: ready_leader diagnostic only; owner fencing may leave predicate true but submit rechecks failure. No maintenance privilege, quorum/durability/read authority or new persistent cache.

limits: Coherent immutable application/provider contract remains required; arbitrary interior mutation or panicking Drop/allocator behavior is not certified.
